title: The Long Static
author: Petra Vasquez
blurb: Astrid Nakamura, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
